plain: Secret scheming, often at a court or in government

webster.text: A plot or scheme of a complicated nature, intended to effect some purpose by secret artifices.

more.text: The plot of a play or romance; a complicated scheme of designs, actions and events, intended to awaken interest in an audience or reader, and make them wait with eager curiosity for the solution or development.

example.quote: Men of factious tempers, of local prejudices, or of sinister designs, may, by intrigue, by corruption, or by other means, first obtain the suffrages, and then betray the interests, of the people.
